text: گھوڑے سائیاں جوڑے، نہیں تاں مٹی دے روڑے۔
romanized: Ghoré saian joré, nahi ta mitti de roré.
literal_en: Horses should be broken in by their masters, otherwise they are clods of earth

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
